comment: RebM is the rebeccamycin sugar 4′-O-methyltransferase that catalyzes the final tailoring step in rebeccamycin biosynthesis. It transfers a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to the 4′-hydroxy group of 4′-demethylrebeccamycin, forming rebeccamycin and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 fixed ambiguous stereochemistry in smarts.

reactions.description: 4′-O-methylation of 4′-demethylrebeccamycin to rebeccamycin using SAM as the methyl donor.
